display_name: 独立模型与接收 IQ、DURA 的源域配对诊断
description: 冻结独立恢复器，对同一源 IQ 比较原始接收、直接恢复和 DURA 输出波形误差，不读取 F、TX 标签、V 或目标。

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source IQ reconstruction error only; no identity accuracy or independent generalization

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed direct dual-domain checkpoint and frozen original DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Runtime verifies direct source-only checkpoint commit and permission fields, frozen_dura verifies DURA provenance
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both fixed Phase1 models, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed trained direct model and DURA, no target score selection

expected_artifacts: result.json with source group mean NMSE and per-record paired improvement counts

metric_names: source IQ NMSE of received, direct, DURA

rows.method: Frozen direct and DURA on the same 672 source IQ pairs
rows.purpose: Identify whether the direct model reduces received-source IQ error
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.

notes: Source samples previously inspected; DURA may have seen their source domain.
No F, TX label, V or target read and no model updates.
Real-checkpoint source smoke runs first; GPU7 batch 32.
